Signature.purpose: Docs-site heading section with expand state and read progress
Signature.description: Docs-site override of the default MDSection: the H1 section carries expand-all and collapse-all controls, while H2 and H3 sections open and close through DocsService and collapse to a single button once the reader marks them as read.

Prop.description: Heading level this section was built from
Stable section key used for the opened and progress state in DocsService
Optional icon shown before the heading of a level 2 or 3 section

Slot.name: default
Slot.description: Block content belonging to the section

header.class: flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 border-b-2 border-primary

section.class: level-{level} overflow-hidden rounded-r-box {level==2 ? 'mb-3 border-l-4 border-primary/80' : 'mb-2 border-l-2 border-primary/40'}

header.class: flex group items-center gap-3 px-4 cursor-pointer transition-colors {level==2 ? 'py-3 bg-base-200/70 hover:bg-base-200' : 'py-2 bg-base-200/35 hover:bg-base-200/60'}
